text: It sounds like Apple is going to launch a ton of new stuff this fall — including a cult-favorite fans have been waiting years for (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jul 11, 2018, 5:18 pm 6 pts A well-known analyst has issued a new research note with predictions for Apple's fall product lineup.
